aliases: Derivation of the Core Operation Universe
note: Step 272A (2026-08-30 22:42), inserted retroactively as a missing prerequisite before Steps 273-275, derives a five-family layered operation universe O_sem = O_S(Assert,Retract,Supersede,Infer,Merge) ∪ O_E(Support,Refute,Qualify,Assess,DetectContradiction,Resolve) ∪ O_O(Query,Compare,Identity,Equal) ∪ O_H(Replay,Trace) ∪ O_G(Authorize,Validate), explicitly excluding representation/infrastructure operations (Serialize,Deserialize,Save,Load,Delete) from the semantic kernel. Establishes the dependency chain O_core -> Requirements(K) -> Candidate(K) -> Minimality(K) -> Sigma and the key non-mapping result that operations do not map one-to-one onto Sigma's state fields (e.g. DetectContradiction does not imply Conflict is a Sigma field). Explicitly labeled 'DERIVED — SUBSTANTIALLY ESTABLISHED', not minimal/complete. Relation to the already-indexed step277-transformation-inventory-ocore-layered-reduction is unclear — Step 277 (per B0043) reduces O_core to a 5-layer typed model with a T_candidate primitive kernel of 6 operations; Step 272A independently derives an 18-22-operation 5-family taxonomy with different membership. Both may be describing overlapping but non-identical operation-universe derivations produced in the same fast-moving corpus window; flagged for reconciliation.

A four-state minimal epistemic-status structure Sigma_min = {Unknown,Supported,Refuted,Conflict}, derived as the power set of two independently-necessary predicates (qualified-support S, qualified-refutation R), isomorphic to {0,1}^2 with a natural partial order (Unknown bottom, Conflict top) and a join-based merge operation sigma1 ⊔ sigma2 = (s1∨s2, r1∨r2). Explicitly separates epistemic state (Sigma) from lifecycle (Lambda: Active/Retracted/Superseded/Archived) and governance (Gamma: Unauthorized/Authorized/Approved/Rejected), stating Sigma ⟂ Lambda ⟂ Gamma as semantic-dimension orthogonality (not statistical independence). Explicitly excludes Missingness, Uncertainty, Contested, Resolution, Validity from Sigma's primitive cardinality. Received a supervisory review in the same file that rates it ACCEPTED — FOUNDATIONAL DERIVATION COMPLETE and hands off to Step 273. NOTE: this is filed as 'step_272b' in its filename but self-titles as 'STEP 272A' in its own body text, creating an ambiguous relationship to the already-indexed step272a-core-operation-universe-layered-derivation (S1799, which established O_core) — likely intended as 272A's second half (deriving Sigma after 272A derived O_core) though the file naming is inconsistent. ALSO POTENTIALLY COMPETING with the already-indexed step275-epistemic-dimension-separation-mandate's proposed Sigma_epi=(D,S) 2-dimensional x 5-level-ordinal structure: this file's Sigma_min is a flat 4-element {0,1}^2 structure with NO strength/degree axis, which is a materially different cardinality and shape from Sigma_epi=(D,S) (which has a 5-level S axis). Flagged for reconciliation — later batches should determine which (if either) is adopted by Step 275/276/277's actual text.

Step 279 (2026-08-30 23:04) is the commissioned executable-implementation step for Step 278's Policy-Authority governance model. Specifies 15 implementation components (Policy, Rule, Authority, Authorization evaluator, Conditional verdict, PolicyEvaluator algorithm, Rule-independence graph evaluator, Measurement evaluator, Calibration, PolicyVersioning, Temporal validity half-open interval, Overlap detector five-way classification, Historical replay, Policy change state machine, Governance event model, five bounded contexts / three aggregates: Policy, Authority, PolicyChange), an executable EvaluatePolicy pseudocode algorithm, and the same F1-F13 falsification programme from Step 278 now as executable test specs. Explicitly declares Step 279 != Empirical Closure and Step 279 != Governance Closure, and that PASS on a test != Theory Proven. An in-file supervisory review CONDITIONALLY ACCEPTS it, listing nine specific underspecification gaps (rule-combination logic, conditional-resolution-strategy execution, calibration procedure, F1-F13 execution specs, convergence conditions, aggregate commands/events, traceability test coverage, per-scale valid operations, deny-over-permit justification) and hands off to 'STEP 279 REVISED — EXECUTION' rather than directly to Step 280.

An ADDENDUM recorded at session close documents the corpus growing live during the scan itself (Steps 269-271 appearing), revising the step-number range to 271 and introducing finding G-13: after roughly Step 258 the primary and verification corpora are 'a single conversation reading itself', so agreement between them is not independent corroboration.

note: Step 280 mandate (2026-08-30 23:16): the commissioned empirical-closure test for the whole Steps 272-279 theory chain against the real KnowledgeOS/EKP implementation. Specifies a minimum 36-case stratified empirical corpus across 12 case classes, 24 named empirical tests E1-E24 (K representation, state equality, epistemic status, missingness, evidence qualification/support/refute, transformation, replay, provenance, lineage, history-vs-state, policy evaluation/change/temporal/propagation, rule independence, measurement, calibration, contradiction, supersession, explanation, end-to-end scenario, round-trip serialization, metamorphic testing), a seven-category mismatch taxonomy (T/I/D/G/UL/C/E), a seven-level evidence hierarchy where only Levels 4-6 count as substantive, ten critical-failure conditions that automatically block empirical closure, and the rule 'Do not make the empirical data fit the theory; make the theory answer to the empirical data.' Requires >=20% negative/boundary cases and independent reproduction where feasible.
